_README: The security checks NetAuditAI answers, as data. Adding a check, a framework mapping or a whole framework is an edit here, not a code change (app.controls.catalog loads and validates this file at start).
needs: the security-fact predicates the check reads (app.facts.predicates, or a boolean predicate declared under 'predicates' below).

judge: the name of a built-in judge in app.controls.judges, or a rule: {"forbid": true} fails when the fact is true, {"require": true} fails when it is false or absent, {"max": n} / {"min": n} bound a number; 'fail' and 'advice' give the finding text.

phase: the order fixes are applied and printed in, so applying them top to bottom never locks the administrator out: 0 establish the safe path (SSH v2, remote logging, time), 1 harden, 2 switch off what the safe path replaced (Telnet, HTTP, SNMP communities), 3 restrict who may manage the device.
mappings: framework requirement ids with the exact framework version; 'vendor' marks a product benchmark item that applies only to that confirmed vendor.
remediation: per-dialect reference commands; each one is applied to a copy and rescanned, and is offered as a fix only when the rescan shows the check now passes.

controls.title: Insecure Management Protocol (Telnet) Enabled
controls.question: Is cleartext Telnet disabled for remote management?

mappings.title: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
Set 'transport input ssh' for 'line vty' connections
Ensure only encrypted access channels are enabled
The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services
The network device must be configured to implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote maintenance sessions

Juniper Junos: delete system services telnet
Palo Alto PAN-OS: set deviceconfig system service disable-telnet yes

controls.title: Insecure HTTP Management Enabled
controls.question: Is cleartext HTTP management disabled?

mappings.title: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
Disable all management related services on WAN port
Ensure only encrypted access channels are enabled
The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services
The network device must be configured to implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote maintenance sessions

Juniper Junos: delete system services web-management http
Palo Alto PAN-OS: set deviceconfig system service disable-http yes

controls.title: Unrestricted Management Access
controls.question: Is management access restricted to trusted sources?

mappings.title: Disable all management related services on WAN port
Ensure all the login accounts having specific trusted hosts enabled
The network device must be configured to enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources

Juniper Junos: set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term MGMT from source-address {management_subnet}
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term MGMT from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term MGMT from destination-port ssh
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term MGMT then accept
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term NO-SSH from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term NO-SSH from destination-port ssh
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term NO-SSH then discard
set firewall family inet filter PROTECT-RE term REST then accept
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input PROTECT-RE

controls.title: Weak or Default SNMP Community Strings
controls.question: Are SNMP communities free of default strings and unrestricted write access?

mappings.title: Do not set 'RW' for any 'snmp-server community'
Set the ACL for each 'snmp-server community'
The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services

Juniper Junos: delete snmp community <community>
Palo Alto PAN-OS: set deviceconfig system snmp-setting access-setting version v3

controls.title: Plaintext or Weakly Encrypted Passwords
controls.question: Are stored passwords protected with strong, non-reversible encoding?

mappings.title: Set 'username secret' for all local users
The network device must be configured to use an encrypted representation of passwords

controls.title: Missing or Disabled Session Timeout
controls.question: Do idle management sessions time out?

mappings.title: Set 'exec-timeout' to less than or equal to 10 minutes 'line console 0'
Set 'exec-timeout' to less than or equal to 10 minutes 'line vty'
Ensure Admin idle timeout time is configured
The network device must be configured to terminate a management session after an organization-defined period of inactivity

Juniper Junos: set system login class <class> idle-timeout 10

controls.title: SSH Version 1 or Weak SSH Configuration
controls.question: Is SSH restricted to protocol version 2?

mappings.title: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
The network device must be configured to implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote maintenance sessions
The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services

Juniper Junos: set system services ssh protocol-version v2

controls.title: AAA (Authentication, Authorization, Accounting) Not Configured
controls.question: Is AAA enabled for administrative access?

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to use an authentication server to authenticate users prior to granting administrative access

Juniper Junos: set system tacplus-server <server> secret <secret>
set system authentication-order [ tacplus password ]
Palo Alto PAN-OS: set shared server-profile tacplus <profile> server <name> address <server> secret <secret>
set shared authentication-profile <profile> method tacplus server-profile <profile>
Arista EOS: aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local

controls.title: Missing Login Banner
controls.question: Is a legal warning banner shown before login?

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to display the Standard Mandatory DoD Notice and Consent Banner before granting access
Acceptable use of information and other associated assets

Juniper Junos: set system login message "{banner_text}"

controls.title: Management Reachable from an Untrusted Interface
controls.question: Are management services kept off external (internet-facing) interfaces and zones?

mappings.title: Disable all management related services on WAN port
The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services

controls.title: SNMPv1/v2c in Use
controls.question: Is SNMP limited to version 3, with no community-based (v1/v2c) access?

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services

Juniper Junos: delete snmp community <community>
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user <user> authentication-sha authentication-password <password>
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user <user> privacy-aes128 privacy-password <password>
Palo Alto PAN-OS: set deviceconfig system snmp-setting access-setting version v3
Arista EOS: snmp-server user <user> <group> v3 auth sha <password> priv aes <password>

controls.title: No Login Brute-Force Protection
controls.question: Does the device limit failed login attempts (10 or fewer before a lockout or disconnect)?

Juniper Junos: set system login retry-options tries-before-disconnect 3
set system login retry-options lockout-period 15

controls.title: Weak Password Policy
controls.question: Does the device enforce a minimum password length of at least 8 characters?

Juniper Junos: set system login password minimum-length 12

controls.title: Default Administrator Account in Use
controls.question: Are local administrative accounts renamed from vendor defaults such as 'admin' or 'root'?

controls.title: Direct Root Login over SSH Allowed
controls.question: Is the root (superuser) account prevented from logging in directly over SSH?
controls.optional_feature: a root account that can log in over SSH

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources

Juniper Junos: set system services ssh root-login deny

controls.title: Overly Permissive Firewall/ACL Rules
controls.question: Does every ACL and firewall policy avoid permitting all traffic from any source to any destination?

mappings.title: Ensure that policies do not use "ALL" as Service

controls.title: IP Source Routing Enabled
controls.question: Is IP source routing disabled?

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services

controls.title: Discovery Protocol (CDP/LLDP) Enabled on External Interface
controls.question: Are discovery protocols disabled on external interfaces?

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to prohibit the use of all unnecessary and nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, and services

controls.title: Router Interface Hardening (Redirects, Proxy-ARP, Directed Broadcast)
controls.question: Do routed interfaces refuse to send ICMP redirects, answer proxy-ARP or forward directed broadcasts?

controls.title: No Remote Syslog Server Configured
controls.question: Are logs forwarded to a remote log server?

mappings.title: Store on Separate Physical Systems or Components
The network device must be configured to offload audit records onto a different system than the system being audited

Juniper Junos: set system syslog host {syslog_server} any notice
Palo Alto PAN-OS: set shared log-settings syslog <profile> server <name> server {syslog_server}

controls.title: NTP Not Configured or Unauthenticated
controls.question: Is the clock synchronized from authenticated NTP servers?

mappings.title: Ensure correct system time is configured through NTP
The network device must be configured to synchronize internal information system clocks with the primary and secondary time sources
The network device must be configured to authenticate Network Time Protocol sources

Juniper Junos: set system ntp authentication-key {ntp_key_id} type sha256 value {ntp_key}
set system ntp trusted-key {ntp_key_id}
set system ntp server {ntp_server} key {ntp_key_id}

controls.title: Traffic Rules That Do Not Log
controls.question: Does every firewall rule that permits traffic log what it matches?

Palo Alto PAN-OS: set rulebase security rules <rule> log-end yes

controls.title: Weak VPN/IPsec Cryptographic Algorithms
controls.question: Do VPN proposals avoid weak encryption, hashing and Diffie-Hellman groups?

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote maintenance sessions

controls.title: Weak Management Cryptography (SSH/HTTPS)
controls.question: Do SSH and HTTPS management avoid weak ciphers, MACs and key exchange (DES, 3DES, RC4, CBC, MD5, DH group 1)?

mappings.title: The network device must be configured to implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote maintenance sessions

Juniper Junos: set system services ssh ciphers [ aes256-ctr aes192-ctr aes128-ctr ]
set system services ssh macs [ hmac-sha2-512 hmac-sha2-256 ]
